PC: Stability assessment: pulse ox, vitals, mental status
Place pads on patient, attach leads, turn on defibrillator
Atropine 0.5 mg IV every 3-5 min. Max dose of 3 mg
If Atropine ineffective: Transcutaneous pacing* rate 60-90 OR Epinephrine 2 to 10 μg/min ORDopamine 2 to 10 μg/kg/min ORIsoproterenol 2 to 10 mcg/min
MK: Identify rhythm on monitor / assess appropriateness forclinical condition
